repository_dependency.pr_131_result: I is the Y=+1/2 complex SU(2)_L doublet from a (2,2) of SO(4)
repository_dependency.pr_281_result: SO(6)/(SO(4)xSO(2)) supplies two light pNGB electroweak doublets with separable roles

derivation.hypercharge_rule: Y=T_R^3+X with X=0 for the scalar candidate

scope_limit: This gate establishes only low-energy SU(2)_L x U(1)_Y compatibility of the role-separated second pNGB doublet with the previously frozen protected-I electroweak quantum numbers. It does not establish SO(10) compatibility, the protected-I mass, radiative stability, portal suppression, precision viability, or publication readiness.
